slides.image_prompt: Dario Amodei waist-up inside a stone US Treasury vault, expression resolute and defiant, eyes hard to camera, both hands pressed flat onto twin skyscraper-tall stacks of hundred-dollar bills, loose bills drifting in the air behind him, the Claude logo exactly as in the reference image glowing amber on the vault arch above, iron-gated dark ledger shelves packed floor-to-ceiling on every wall. slides.headline: 1) WRITE YOUR BANK FOR A LOWER RATE TONIGHT
slides.body: Banks lower rates when you ask the right way. Most owners never ask. Prompt: 'Write a letter to my bank requesting a lower interest rate on my business loan. My payment record: [details].'

slides.headline: 2) FIND WHERE INFLATION EATS YOUR MARGIN
slides.body: Paste 3 months of expenses. Claude finds every cost that outpaced your prices. Prompt: 'Here are my expenses for 3 months. Find where costs grew faster than prices and rank them.'

slides.headline: 3) REPRICE YOUR BUSINESS BEFORE CUSTOMERS NOTICE
slides.body: Raising prices flat kills your cheapest customers. AI redesigns your price list to protect margin where it matters. Prompt: 'My costs rose [X]%. Rewrite my prices to protect margin without losing budget customers.'
slides.image_prompt: Close-up of a bare hand gripping a thick black marker drawing a hard slash through a price on a paper hang-tag dangling from a product, a fresh bold $ symbol written in large strokes directly below the slash, warm blurred product shelf softly lit in the background. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, slight film grain. Accent: slate black against warm cream.

slides.headline: 4) FIND A CHEAPER SUPPLIER IN 10 MINUTES
slides.body: Most owners overpay for supplies for years and never check. AI finds three cheaper alternatives in minutes. Prompt: 'I spend $[X]/month on [product]. Find 3 cheaper USA suppliers I can switch to today.'

slides.headline: 5) STRESS-TEST YOUR CASH FOR THE NEXT 90 DAYS
slides.body: Most businesses don't fail for lack of ideas. They run out of cash. Prompt: 'Here are my monthly numbers. Tell me the exact month I run out of cash if revenue drops 20%.'
slides.image_prompt: A heavy steel wall safe hanging wide open, interior nearly bare, a single gold coin lying flat on the bottom shelf, a harsh overhead spotlight cutting a tight bright circle into deep surrounding shadow, the thick safe door casting a hard diagonal shadow across the frame. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, slight film grain. Accent: amber gold against deep charcoal.

slides.headline: 6) BUILD A RECESSION PLAN TONIGHT FOR FREE
slides.body: A 30% revenue drop closes most businesses within 90 days. AI builds your survival plan in minutes. Prompt: 'If my revenue dropped 30%, give me a cost-cutting plan to stay profitable. My business: [describe].'
